about_the_game:
oh Noooo...

you overslept for the Party didn't You?

why are you Always doing things like that?

how Are you going to get ready in Time?

What are you looking for?

-----

Explore your apartment as you desperately try to get ready for a party. Navigate multiple rooms, and distractions in your preparation quest. Collect over 100 unique items to discover the ultimate inventory for party preparedness. Chat with your friends along the way on your new and smart phone. Discover unique events and interactions, complete quests, and discover the countless secrets of Striatum.

-----

Features

  • A retro first-person point-and-click PC adventure game with a colorful and surreal mid-90s low-poly 3D style.

  • Race the clock to prepare yourself for a party. Navigate competing distractions to be as prepared as possible.

  • A lovingly handcrafted open-apartment environment full of interactions and hundreds of unique items to collect.

  • Branching pathways and dialogue, multiple ending scenarios, and secrets to unlock encourage multiple playthroughs to discover everything.

  • An in-game smart phone interface. Have branching conversations with your friends to influence your relationship with them, keep track of important tasks, and find out all of the other amazing things technology can do for you!

short_description: A quickplay and replayable first-person point-and-click adventure with a low-poly 3D retro style about getting ready for a party, featuring branching story paths with multiple in-game characters, 100+ items to discover and collect, and many interactions and events.
